signature.name: VTask.inclusion
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> (R : ι → Type u_2) -> (A : (i : ι) → Set (R i)) -> {𝓕 𝓖 : Filter ι} -> (h : 𝓕 ≤ 𝓖) -> (x : RestrictedProduct (fun i => R i) (fun i => A i) 𝓖) -> RestrictedProduct (fun i => R i) (fun i => A i) 𝓕

conventions.statement: For every index i, evaluating VTask.inclusion R A h x at i returns exactly x i; the underlying tuple is unchanged.
conventions.note: The inclusion only changes the filter annotation, not the tuple data.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} (R : ι → Type*) (A : (i : ι) → Set (R i)) {𝓕 𝓖 : Filter ι} (h : 𝓕 ≤ 𝓖), Function.Injective (VTask.inclusion R A h)

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} (R : ι → Type*) (A : (i : ι) → Set (R i)) [∀ i, TopologicalSpace (R i)] {𝓕 𝓖 : Filter ι} (h : 𝓕 ≤ 𝓖), Continuous (VTask.inclusion R A h)

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} (R : ι → Type*) (A : (i : ι) → Set (R i)) {𝓕 𝓖 : Filter ι} (h : 𝓕 ≤ 𝓖), Set.range (VTask.inclusion R A h) = {x | ∀ᶠ i in 𝓖, x i ∈ A i}

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} (R : ι → Type*) (A : (i : ι) → Set (R i)) [∀ i, TopologicalSpace (R i)] (hAopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (A i)) {S : Set ι} (hS : Filter.cofinite ≤ Filter.principal S) (x : RestrictedProduct (fun i => R i) (fun i => A i) (Filter.principal S)), nhds (VTask.inclusion R A hS x) = Filter.map (VTask.inclusion R A hS) (nhds x)

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} (R : ι → Type*) (A : (i : ι) → Set (R i)) {𝓕 𝓖 : Filter ι} (h : 𝓕 ≤ 𝓖) (U : Set (RestrictedProduct (fun i => R i) (fun i => A i) 𝓕)), (DFunLike.coe '' (VTask.inclusion R A h ⁻¹' U)) ⊆ (DFunLike.coe '' U)

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} (R : ι → Type*) (A : (i : ι) → Set (R i)) {𝓕 𝓖 : Filter ι} (h : 𝓕 ≤ 𝓖), 𝓕 ≠ 𝓖 → ∃ x : RestrictedProduct (fun i => R i) (fun i => A i) 𝓖, (VTask.inclusion R A h x : RestrictedProduct (fun i => R i) (fun i => A i) 𝓕) = VTask.inclusion R A h x
